owner_path: RuntimeManagerClient.list_by_plan(case plan) then retire(binding) -> POST /api/runtime-bindings/{id}/retire on the Runtime owner, using the BFF's existing runtime-manager service authority (no MFA header or claim added; MFA enforced by owner only when configured)
forbidden_paths_not_used: new endpoint, issuer, MFA grant or config

served_case_rule.accepted: this run's case stays; all other active release cases retired
served_case_rule.compensated: only this run's case is retired; every other case (incl. the previously served baseline) is untouched

dry_run: docker exec -i pantheon-operator-bff-1 python - --dry-run --outcome accepted < scripts/retire_dev_paper_release_cases.py
limitation: hosted success/readback of the original retire handler is confirmed by the first hosted Root run; worker performed no hosted action
coverage: coordinate-dev-release step (accepted/compensated) and deploy-dev step after deploy_compensation (compensated before coordinator runs)
identity_assertions: binding plan_id, metadata.tenant_id and deployment_mode=paper must match the case; mismatch or unreadable state -> zero writes for that case; accepted run with unknown/unreadable/inactive served case refuses with zero writes
